segments.sn22.94:1.2: “Nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, lokena vivadāmi, lokova mayā vivadati.
segments.sn22.94:1.3: Na, bhikkhave, dhammavādī kenaci lokasmiṃ vivadati.
segments.sn22.94:1.4: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, natthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ, ahampi taṃ ‘natthī’ti vadāmi.
segments.sn22.94:1.5: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ, ahampi taṃ ‘atthī’ti vadāmi”.
segments.sn22.94:2.1: “Kiñca, bhikkhave, natthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ, yamahaṃ ‘natthī’ti vadāmi?
segments.sn22.94:2.2: Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ natthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ; ahampi taṃ ‘natthī’ti vadāmi.
segments.sn22.94:2.3: Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ natthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ;
segments.sn22.94:2.7: Idaṃ kho, bhikkhave, natthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ; ahampi taṃ ‘natthī’ti vadāmi”.
segments.sn22.94:3.1: “Kiñca, bhikkhave, atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ, yamahaṃ ‘atthī’ti vadāmi?
segments.sn22.94:3.2: Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ; ahampi taṃ ‘atthī’ti vadāmi.
segments.sn22.94:3.3: Vedanā aniccā … pe … viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ;
segments.sn22.94:3.5: Idaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ; ahampi taṃ ‘atthī’ti vadāmi”.
segments.sn22.94:4.1: “Atthi, bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo, taṃ tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti;
segments.sn22.94:4.2: abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā taṃ ācikkhati deseti paññapeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti.
segments.sn22.94:5.1: “Kiñca, bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo, taṃ tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti, abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti paññapeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti?
segments.sn22.94:5.2: Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo taṃ tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti.
segments.sn22.94:5.3: Abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti paññapeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti.
segments.sn22.94:6.1: “Yo, bhikkhave, tathāgatena evaṃ ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññapiyamāne paṭṭhapiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkariyamāne na jānāti na passati tamahaṃ, bhikkhave, bālaṃ puthujjanaṃ andhaṃ acakkhukaṃ ajānantaṃ apassantaṃ kinti karomi!
segments.sn22.94:6.2: Vedanā, bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo … pe … saññā, bhikkhave … saṅkhārā, bhikkhave … viññāṇaṃ, bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo taṃ tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti.
segments.sn22.94:6.6: Abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti paññapeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti.
segments.sn22.94:7.1: “Yo, bhikkhave, tathāgatena evaṃ ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññapiyamāne paṭṭhapiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkariyamāne na jānāti na passati tamahaṃ, bhikkhave, bālaṃ puthujjanaṃ andhaṃ acakkhukaṃ ajānantaṃ apassantaṃ kinti karomi!
segments.sn22.94:8.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaḍḍhaṃ udakā accuggamma ṭhāti [tiṭṭhantaṃ (ka.)] anupalittaṃ udakena;
segments.sn22.94:8.2: evameva kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato loke jāto loke saṃvaḍḍho lokaṃ abhibhuyya viharati anupalitto lokenā”ti.

lines: Dutiye vivadatīti “aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ anattā asubhan”ti yathāsabhāvena vadantena saddhiṃ “niccaṃ sukhaṃ attā subhan”ti vadanto vivadati.
Mayhañhi paṭipattikathanameva bhāro, paṭipattipūraṇaṃ pana kulaputtānaṃ bhāroti dasseti.
“Nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, lokenā”ti ettha hi sattaloko kathito,“atthi, bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo”ti ettha saṅkhāraloko,“tathāgato loke jāto loke saṃvaḍḍho”ti ettha okāsaloko kathito.
Kathaṃ karomīti kena pakārenāhaṃ bālaṃ ajānantaṃ karomi.
Tathā cāha “akkhāto vo mayā maggo”tiādi (dha. pa.275).
“Tayo lokā kathitā”ti vatvā taṃ vivarituṃ “nāhaṃ, bhikkhave”tiādimāha.
